meta.title: TriggerHub | Automation for creator and streaming workflows
meta.description: TriggerHub automates creator and streaming workflows with triggers, macros, and desktop integrations for focused local execution.
meta.ogDescription: Automate repetitive creator workflows with local triggers, macros, and desktop actions from one hub.

footer.productInfo: Product information reflects the current desktop scope available in this repository and public release path.

hero.title: Automate repetitive creator workflows from one desktop hub.
hero.description: TriggerHub is a Windows desktop automation app for creators who want triggers, macros, and tool actions to work together locally. The current repository supports a focused product scope with core automation modules, OBS and Spotify adapters, plugin scaffolding, and a documented Windows release path.
proofPoints: Runs as a Windows desktop product

benefits.title: Less manual switching. More control during live workflows.
benefits.description: The strongest product story in the repository is not breadth. It is the ability to reduce repeated desktop tasks and keep creator workflows in one local control layer.

features.title: A focused feature set that reflects the current product scope.
features.description: This page keeps the message tied to what the repository actually supports today, without stretching into roadmap claims or generic automation language.

workflow.title: Build the workflow once, then let the desktop runtime carry it.
workflow.description: TriggerHub is structured around a simple product model: react to an event, apply logic, and execute the resulting action locally.

extensions.title: The product can grow into deeper creator tooling without losing focus.
extensions.description: These ideas are framed deliberately as possible extensions because the repository already supports the underlying direction through desktop control, plugin scaffolding, clip tooling, and roadmap notes for AI-assisted workflows.

trust.title: A product message grounded in existing implementation.
trust.description: The website should feel credible. These points stay close to the repository evidence instead of marketing claims the current codebase cannot support.

faq.title: Clear answers before you request access.
faq.description: These answers reflect the current repository state and keep the public message aligned with the actual product scope.

items.title: Reduce live setup friction
items.description: Move repetitive actions out of your manual workflow so you can stay focused on the stream instead of juggling tools.

items.title: Keep control on your machine
items.description: TriggerHub is positioned as local desktop software, which keeps automation close to the apps and devices you already use.

items.title: Unify repeated routines
items.description: Bring events, conditions, macros, and actions into one workflow model instead of splitting them across separate tools.

items.title: Trigger-based workflows
items.description: The repository already contains the trigger engine and execution graph that power event-driven automations.
bullets: Built to coordinate repeated creator routines

items.title: Reusable macros
items.description: Macro orchestration is part of the current desktop foundation, making multi-step automations easier to repeat and maintain.

items.title: Focused desktop integrations
items.description: Current repository evidence supports OBS control, Spotify actions, clip export modules, and plugin-ready extension points.

items.title: Choose the event
items.description: Start with the event you want to react to in your desktop setup, then define the trigger that should launch the workflow.

items.title: Add logic and macros
items.description: Use conditions and reusable macro sequences to control when an automation should continue and what should happen next.

items.title: Run the action locally
items.description: Let the runtime execute the connected action on your machine so the workflow can respond without extra manual switching.

items.title: Desktop-first direction
items.description: The repository positions TriggerHub as local desktop software with a clear creator-workflow focus.

items.title: Implemented core modules
items.description: Trigger engine, macro system, service adapters, and plugin scaffolding are present in the current repository.

items.title: Local-first product scope
items.description: The product is framed as desktop software rather than a cloud dashboard, which keeps the message clear and credible.

items.title: Quality baseline in place
items.description: The repository includes automated tests and a production build pipeline for the website and desktop codebase.

items.title: Touch-first control surfaces
items.description: Project references already point to a second-display or tablet-oriented control experience. That makes touch-friendly surfaces such as soundboards or stream controls a credible extension path.
bullets: Secondary touch display or connected tablet operation is documented as a target direction
Soundboard workflows are referenced in project reference and starter documents
Fits the desktop-control positioning instead of expanding into unrelated SaaS features

items.title: Plugin-based clip workflows
items.description: Because plugin scaffolding and clip export modules already exist, a future plugin layer for richer clip handling is a plausible product extension.
bullets: Clip export is already part of the repository scope
Plugin system is implemented as an extension point
Content tooling and clip enhancements are already part of the roadmap direction

items.title: AI-assisted post-production
items.description: The roadmap already names AI-assisted creator workflows as a later direction. A future editor-style plugin for clip refinement, planning, and publishing can therefore be framed as a possible expansion, not as a shipping feature.
bullets: Positioned explicitly as a possible extension, not as current functionality
Grounded in roadmap notes about AI-assisted creator workflows
Keeps the website honest while still showing where the platform could grow

items.question: What kind of product is TriggerHub today?
items.answer: The current repository supports TriggerHub as a Windows desktop automation product for creator workflows, with a public website and a documented release path.

items.question: Which integrations are supported by the current codebase?
items.answer: The repository currently shows OBS and Spotify service adapters, clip modules, and plugin scaffolding. This website does not claim broader integrations beyond that evidence.

items.question: Is TriggerHub a cloud SaaS?
items.answer: No. The current product framing is local desktop software that runs on your machine and coordinates actions from there.

items.question: Which platform is currently targeted?
items.answer: The existing packaging and release guidance in the repository target Windows x64 desktop delivery.

cta.title: Follow the product direction without promising a public download yet.
cta.description: The current public site should frame TriggerHub as a focused desktop product in development. The next step is protected access or a review of the repository and product scope.

features.title: Powerful Features
features.description: Click any feature to learn more about how it works

items.title: Visual Automation Editor
items.description: Drag-and-drop interface to build complex workflows without code

expandedContent.explanation: Build sophisticated automation workflows using our intuitive visual editor. Connect triggers, conditions, and actions with simple drag-and-drop interactions. No coding required - just connect the dots.
expandedContent.example: Trigger: Stream Started -> Condition: Scene = Gaming -> Action: Play Playlist

items.title: Multi-Tool Integration
items.description: Connect OBS, Spotify, Discord and your favorite creator tools

expandedContent.explanation: TriggerHub seamlessly connects with all major creator tools. Our integration engine allows real-time communication between your streaming software, music players, chat platforms, and more.
expandedContent.example: Connect OBS scenes with Spotify playlists and Discord webhooks

items.title: Plugin System
items.description: Extend functionality with community plugins and custom integrations

expandedContent.explanation: Our open plugin architecture lets you extend TriggerHub's capabilities. Install community-created plugins or build your own using our comprehensive SDK. The possibilities are endless.

items.title: Creator Workflow Automation
items.description: Built specifically for streamers and content creators

expandedContent.explanation: Unlike generic automation tools, TriggerHub is designed from the ground up for creator workflows. Every feature is optimized for streaming, content creation, and audience engagement.
expandedContent.example: Auto-switch scenes, manage audio, trigger alerts, all in one platform

items.title: Real Time Triggers
items.description: Instant reactions to events with millisecond precision

expandedContent.explanation: TriggerHub operates in real-time with sub-100ms latency. Events trigger actions instantly, ensuring your automations feel responsive and professional. Perfect for live streaming where timing matters.
expandedContent.example: New follower alert plays within 50ms of the follow event

items.title: Local Desktop Control
items.description: Runs locally on your machine with full system access

expandedContent.explanation: TriggerHub runs entirely on your local machine, giving it full access to control your streaming software and tools. No cloud delays, no privacy concerns - everything happens on your desktop.
expandedContent.example: Direct control over OBS, audio devices, and system applications
